one_line_description: E-commerce platform with APIs for store management
auth_methods_evidence: BigCommerce supports OAuth2 for apps and API keys (Bearer tokens) for store API. Nango lists OAUTH2. https://developer.bigcommerce.com/api-reference
self_serve_evidence: The documentation shows API token creation endpoints that developers can use without contacting sales
buildability_rationale: Good documentation with broad API coverage and self-serve authentication, though some endpoints may require enterprise features
agent_notes: The documentation shows extensive API coverage for both storefront and admin operations with clear authentication methods [NANGO CROSS-CHECK: Nango lists OAUTH2. Updated — BigCommerce supports both OAuth2 and API keys.]
